description: Project-level Claude Code settings for the Yu-Gi-Oh GX Spirit Caller decomp. Hooks enforce ruff/test/invariants gates so the agent catches drift in-loop rather than at CI, and capture session-end summaries to a shared inbox so the brain can read what the other agents said without manual copy-paste. Keep in sync with docs/decomp-workflow.md § Local setup extras. Hook interpreter is `python3`, and that name is REQUIRED to resolve or the hooks silently do nothing. macOS is why: Apple's CLT ships `python3` with no plain `python`, and Linux distros follow the same convention. WINDOWS DOES NOT GUARANTEE IT — python.org installers ship `python.exe`; `python3.exe` comes from the Microsoft Store build and is otherwise absent. On the machine where this note was written `python3.exe` existed only because it had been copied from `python.exe` by hand. If `python3` does not resolve on a Windows box, install Python from the Microsoft Store or place a `python3` shim beside `python`. tests/test_claude_hook_interpreter.py fails loudly rather than letting the hooks degrade to silent no-ops.
